method: Original RGBA pixels read after existing clipRects; major two boot components plus bounded torso/cap foreground; virtual source512 ground460; source scale displayHeight/512. All 720 frame diagnostic contact sheets visually inspected. Non-idle lunge, rotation, recoil, death and one-foot contact treated as action pose changes instead of automatic defects.

notes: Attack follow-through can turn the whole character away; this is the original intentional strike/rotation sequence rather than runtime flip inconsistency.
Rifle-spear B standing arm/weapon angle changes, but isolated anatomical anchors remain stable after registration.
Kirkhammer A sword tip and Chikage A trailing blade contaminate whole-foot-band bounding boxes. Major boot components remove these false positives.
Walk and attack poses deliberately alter footprint, including raised feet; automatic source-centroid centering would remove lunges or produce new jumps.
Common skin offsets were proposed for review but rejected; only confirmed idle0 relative placement errors were corrected.

limitations: This pixel/atlas audit is distinct from actual browser playback; root performs browser verification.
A maximum drift under 2px checks anatomical registration, not artistic quality of every independent generated pose.
Original artwork was retained; no bitmap edits, additional artwork or changes to animation frame sequences were made.
